artifact_schema.description: A rank-at-least-30 curve outside the published curve #273 j-invariant class, with an exact independence witness.

curve.description: The five integral coefficients [a1, a2, a3, a4, a6], each as a canonical decimal string.

points.description: Between 30 and 64 affine rational points. Each point is [x, y] in canonical exact string form.

statement: Find a second, structurally distinct elliptic curve over Q of rank at least 30. The integral equation must have a j-invariant different from curve #273, so copying, rescaling, or twisting the published record cannot settle this objective. Submit 30 to 64 rational points. The pinned evaluator first proves the full submitted set independent modulo torsion using exact Cremona-Brumer quadratic characters and a root-free good reduction at deterministic primes p <= 10000, then compares j = c4^3/Delta by exact cross multiplication against the published baseline. It returns the certified point count only when both conditions hold; threshold 30 therefore proves a different j-class with rank E(Q) >= 30. This does not assert exact rank or methodological novelty. Baseline: https://elliptic-rank.icarm.cloud/curve/273.
